name: Infrastructure Auto Remediation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/5 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  infraHealthCheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Check Redis Health
        id: redis_check
        run: |
          # Check Redis connectivity and memory usage
          REDIS_HEALTH=$(timeout 10 bash -c 'redis-cli -h ${{ secrets.REDIS_HOST }} -p ${{ secrets.REDIS_PORT }} ping' 2>/dev/null || echo "FAIL")
          if [[ "$REDIS_HEALTH" == "PONG" ]]; then
            echo "redis_status=healthy" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "redis_memory=$(redis-cli -h ${{ secrets.REDIS_HOST }} -p ${{ secrets.REDIS_PORT }} info memory | grep used_memory_human | cut -d':' -f2)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "redis_status=unhealthy" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Check PostgreSQL Health
        id: postgres_check
        run: |
          # Check PostgreSQL connectivity
          PG_HEALTH=$(timeout 10 psql -h ${{ secrets.POSTGRES_HOST }} -p ${{ secrets.POSTGRES_PORT }} -U ${{ secrets.POSTGRES_USER }} -d ${{ secrets.POSTGRES_DB }} -c "SELECT 1;" 2>/dev/null || echo "FAIL")
          if [[ "$PG_HEALTH" == *"1"* ]]; then
            echo "postgres_status=healthy" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "postgres_status=unhealthy" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Create OpsGenie Alert for P1 Issues
        if: (env.redis_status == 'unhealthy' || env.postgres_status == 'unhealthy')
        run: |
          # Create OpsGenie alert with dedup alias
          ALERT_MESSAGE="Infrastructure health check failed"
          DEDUP_ALIAS="infra-health-${{ github.run_id }}"
          
          curl -X POST https://api.opsgenie.com/v2/alerts \
            -H "Authorization: GenieKey ${{ secrets.OPSGENIE_API_KEY }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{
              "message": "'"$ALERT_MESSAGE"'",
              "alias": "'"$DEDUP_ALIAS"'",
              "priority": "P1",
              "responders": [
                {
                  "type": "team",
                  "name": "Platform Team"
                }
              ]
            }'

      - name: Rate Limiting Check
        id: rate_limit_check
        run: |
          # Implement rate limiting logic
          LAST_RUN_FILE="/tmp/last_infra_run"
          NOW=$(date +%s)
          if [[ -f "$LAST_RUN_FILE" ]]; then
            LAST_RUN=$(cat "$LAST_RUN_FILE")
            TIME_DIFF=$((NOW - LAST_RUN))
            if [[ $TIME_DIFF -lt 300 ]]; then
              echo "rate_limited=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
              echo "Skipping due to rate limit (cooldown period)"
            else
              echo $NOW > "$LAST_RUN_FILE"
            fi
          else
            echo $NOW > "$LAST_RUN_FILE"
          fi

      - name: Trigger Auto-Remediation Pipeline
        if: (env.redis_status == 'unhealthy' || env.postgres_status == 'unhealthy') && env.rate_limited != 'true'
        run: |
          # Trigger auto-remediation workflow
          gh workflow run infra-auto-remediation.yml --repo ${{ github.repository }}

  autoRemediate:
    needs: infraHealthCheck
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.schedule && github.event_name == 'schedule')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Investigate P1 Alert
        run: |
          # Perform investigation with read-only access
          echo "Investigating P1 alert..."
          # Placeholder for actual investigation logic
          echo "Investigation completed"

      - name: Safe Cleanup
        run: |
          # Perform safe cleanup operations
          echo "Performing safe cleanup..."
          # Placeholder for actual cleanup logic
          echo "Cleanup completed"

      - name: Post Findings to Discord
        if: always()
        run: |
          # Post findings to Discord channel
          echo "Posting findings to Discord..."

      - name: Create GH Issue for Human Review
        if: failure()
        run: |
          # Create GH issue when human intervention is needed
          gh issue create \
            --title "Manual Intervention Required: Infrastructure Alert" \
            --body "Automated remediation failed. Manual review required." \
            --label "needs-human"

  publicHealthEndpoint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Serve Public Health Endpoint
        run: |
          # This would typically be handled by your backend service
          # For demonstration purposes, we'll simulate serving the endpoint
          echo "Serving public health endpoint at /api/status/health"
          # In practice, this would be part of your Express.js or similar backend
          # Example response structure:
          # {
          #   "status": "healthy",
          #   "services": {
          #     "redis": "healthy",
          #     "postgresql": "healthy"
          #   }
          # }
